            for (int i = 0; i <= fifty - f; ++i) {
                if (i * 50 > K) break;
                for (int j = 0; j <= hundred - h; ++j) {
                    if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                    int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                    if (totalW > K) break;
                    long combVal = (nCk(fifty - f, i) * nCk(hundred - h, j)) % MOD;
                    ans = (int) ((ans + combVal * solve2(0, f + i, h + j, r - 1)) % MOD);
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i <= f; ++i) {
                if (i * 50 > K) break;
                for (int j = 0; j <= h; ++j) {

                    int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;

                    ans = (int) ((ans + combVal * solve2(1, f - i, h - j, r - 1)) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
        return memo2[t][f][h][r] = ans;
    }

    static long nCk(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k) return 0;
        if (k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
        if (comb[n][k] != -1) return comb[n][k];
        if (n - k < k) return comb[n][k] = nCk(n, n - k);
        long temp = ((long) n * nCk(n - 1, k - 1)) % MOD;
        return comb[n][k] = (temp * pow(k, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
    }

    static long pow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
